blocks.title: Luminosity
blocks.text: Luminosity, L, sitare ki fi ikai waqt electromagnetic shuaon ki shakal mein kharij hone wali kul tawanai hai: sitare ki kharij shuaon ki kul taqat, watts mein napi gayi. Yeh sitare ki asal (intrinsic) chamak batati hai.

Sitare ki luminosity zyada tar us ke radius aur satah ke darja hararat par munhasir hai. Bare sitaron ke paas shuaein kharij karne ke liye zyada satah hai, is liye woh zyada roshan hote hain; barabar size ke do sitaron mein zyada satah ke darja hararat wala zyada tawanai kharij karta hai. Luminosity satah ke raqbe, A = 4 pi r^2, aur fi ikai raqba kharij taqat, sigma T^4, ka hasil-e-zarb hai: L = 4 pi r^2 sigma T^4 (21.1). Yeh Stefan-Boltzmann qanoon hai: sitare ki kul taqat us ke satah ke raqbe aur darja hararat ki chauthi taqat ke hasil-e-zarb ke mutanasib hai. Yahan sigma Stefan-Boltzmann constant, 5.67 x 10^-8 W m^-2 K^-4, T satah ka darja hararat aur r sitare ka radius hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat aur kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Sooraj taqreeban 4 x 10^26 watts ki bohat zyada luminosity se chamakta hai, jo har second arbon nuclear dhamakon ke barabar hai. Stefan-Boltzmann qanoon falkiyat-danon ko sirf darja hararat jaan kar sitaron ka size aur chamak andaza lagane mein madad deta hai.

Aik sitare ki luminosity 2.5 x 10^26 W aur satah ka darja hararat 6000 K hai. Sitare ka radius andaza lagayein. Hal: L = 4 pi r^2 sigma T^4 se r = [L / (4 pi sigma T^4)] ka square root = [2.5 x 10^26 W / (4 x 3.14 x 5.67 x 10^-8 W m^-2 K^-4 x (6000 K)^4)] ka square root = 5.2 x 10^8 m.

blocks.prompt: Agar sitara (size wahi rehte hue) dugna garam ho jaye to kitne guna zyada tawanai kharij karega?
blocks.explanation: L, T^4 ke mutanasib hai, is liye 2^4 = 16 guna zyada.

items: Luminosity L: sitare ki kharij kul taqat (W).
Stefan-Boltzmann: L = 4 pi r^2 sigma T^4; sigma = 5.67 x 10^-8 W m^-2 K^-4.
